spell.abyss_spells.abyssal_crush.guide: Unleash deep pressure: AoE damage around you, inflicting Darkness and Slowness.
spell.abyss_spells.retribution.guide: Suffer for 5 seconds, then return it all at once.
spell.abyss_spells.fate_anchor.guide: Remember this moment. Recast within 30 seconds to live it again.
spell.abyss_spells.abyss_core.guide: Launch a drifting core that pulls in the living every 2 seconds. The closer, the deadlier.
spell.abyss_spells.doom_mark.guide: Mark a creature: it erupts after 6 seconds, again and again.
spell.abyss_spells.abyss_offering.guide: Ten seconds of chanting. A tentacle drags the victim down.
spell.abyss_spells.transposition.guide: Trade places with a creature. It is left blinded in the dark.
spell.abyss_spells.blood_price.guide: The abyss takes health and gives mana. Cannot kill you.
spell.abyss_spells.equilibrium.guide: Trade health percentage with a creature. Darkness blinds it for 10 seconds.
spell.abyss_spells.void_claim.guide: Shackle a creature with void tendrils: it cannot move, loses 25% of its mana to you, and takes true damage.

item.abyss_spells.abyss_heart.guide: Focus of the Abyss school for the Scroll Forge
